subject: phase3_dvc_medium_calibration
statement: Close the DVC medium calibration without promoting AgentTeam to a scored pilot and require resource-allocation repairs before another live comparison.
selected_option: retain all three v7 terminal outcomes as calibration evidence, reject promotion, and prepare a new provider-free repair contract

alternatives.option: treat direct and full as model-quality failures and continue the pilot
alternatives.rejected_reason: Both modes terminated at the framework's fixed tool limit before publishing a candidate, so they do not measure completed implementation quality.

alternatives.option: raise the limit and continue the same run
alternatives.rejected_reason: That would mutate the frozen treatment after observing outcomes and invalidate the comparison.

alternatives.option: promote based on the valid single_codex partial score
alternatives.rejected_reason: The instance was unresolved and the AgentTeam modes produced no valid candidate.

rationale: The fresh run completed with 1341524 total tokens and complete usage coverage. single_codex produced an applicable but unresolved patch at 339825 tokens. agentteam_direct consumed 412925 tokens and exhausted the fixed tool budget after patch-context failures. agentteam_full consumed 588774 tokens in taskpack authoring and repository mapping, exhausted the mapping tool budget before handoff publication, and never started implementation. The common acceptance command was non-discriminating in all modes. These outcomes identify runtime allocation defects rather than evidence for promotion.
expected_outcome: Implement and provider-free validate dynamic role/risk tool budgets, durable admission accounting, stage token reservations, grounding reuse, and early handoff publication before authorizing a fresh live calibration.
acceptance_refs: all four provider invocations have reported usage
no scored pilot authorization was emitted
